memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in basic ADLs; uses a walking stick for outdoor walks; manages household chores.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls in the last 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (within normal limit).
medicines: 5 regular (timolol eye drops, latanoprost eye drops, aspirin 81 mg, atorvastatin 10 mg, amlodipine 5 mg). Five or more medicines – polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports feeling well; denies sadness or anxiety.
carers: Son Rajesh.
goals: "I want to keep reading my newspaper without trouble."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – 1 drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – 1 drop in each eye at bedtime
aspirin 81 mg – 1 tablet daily
atorvastatin 10 mg – 1 tablet nightly
amlodipine 5 mg – 1 tablet daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Intraocular pressure (IOP): Right eye 22 mmHg (REF 10‑21), Left eye 20 mmHg (REF 10‑21)
Visual field test: Mild peripheral depression superiorly OD, within normal limits OS
Optic disc assessment: Cup‑disc ratio 0.6 OD, 0.5 OS (mild cupping OD)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Noticed slight blurring of vision when reading fine print; no pain or redness. Using the eye drops as prescribed.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent; walks without stick indoors, uses stick for longer outings.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 3/5 (negative) – annual screen due next year.
falls: 1 fall in the last 12 months (tripped over rug, no injury); gait slightly unsteady; timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise balance exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 5 regular (timolol, latanoprost, aspirin, atorvastatin, amlodipine). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports occasional worry about vision; denies depression.
carers: Son Rajesh.
goals: "I hope to keep walking to the market without feeling unsteady."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – 1 drop in each eye twice daily (continue)
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – 1 drop in each eye at bedtime (continue)
aspirin 81 mg – 1 tablet daily
atorvastatin 10 mg – 1 tablet nightly
amlodipine 5 mg – 1 tablet daily
brimonidine 0.1% eye drops – 1 drop in each eye twice daily (added for IOP control)

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Intraocular pressure (IOP): Right eye 18 mmHg (REF 10‑21), Left eye 17 mmHg (REF 10‑21)
Visual field test: Stable compared to prior; no new defects.
Optic disc assessment: Cup‑disc ratio unchanged.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Comprehensive eye exam (slit lamp, dilated fundus): Anterior segment quiet; no signs of allergic conjunctivitis. Lens clear. Fundus: mild cupping OD as prior, no hemorrhage or exudates. Visual acuity 20/30 OD, 20/25 OS with correction.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages ADLs independently; uses walking stick only for uneven terrain.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (negative) – annual screen passed.
falls: 0 falls in the last 6 months; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 11 seconds (borderline) – advise continued strength training.
medicines: 6 regular (timolol, latanoprost, brimonidine, aspirin, atorvastatin, amlodipine). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria.
mood: Feels cheerful; enjoys gardening.
carers: Son Rajesh.
goals: "I want to see my grandchildren’s faces clearly."

memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – 1 drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – 1 drop in each eye at bedtime

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Intraocular pressure (IOP): Right eye 16 mmHg (REF 10‑21), Left eye 15 mmHg (REF 10‑21)
Visual field test: No progression; stable.
Optic disc assessment: Cup‑disc ratio 0.55 OD, 0.5 OS (stable).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Dr S. Rao, Glaucoma Specialist, Narayana Nethralaya, for further IOP control and possible surgical evaluation. Include recent IOP readings, visual field, and OCT if available.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Specialist review: IOP remains borderline; recommends adding topical carbonic anhydrase inhibitor and considering laser trabeculoplasty. Advised to continue current drops and return in 3 months.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent; walks without aid; reports good balance.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 3/5 (negative) – annual screen due next year.
falls: 0 falls in the last 12 months; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds (within normal).
medicines: 6 regular (timolol, latanoprost, brimonidine, aspirin, atorvastatin, amlodipine). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria.
mood: Content; enjoys daily walks.
carers: Son Rajesh.
goals: "I wish to maintain my independence and enjoy my hobbies."
